name: Partial oxidation and gasification
principle: Coal, petroleum coke, heavy oil or gas is partly burned with oxygen at high temperature to make syngas, which is shifted to hydrogen and purified. NETL's coal case uses a dry-feed, oxygen-blown entrained-flow slagging gasifier at about 1,427 degC, sour shift, MDEA acid gas removal, and PSA giving 99.9% hydrogen. Capture can be added; NSTA reports POX with methanation at 96 to 97% capture.
